protocol: Observed known-target effects transferred between2 donor labels in same external experiment. Both guides aggregated, all8 control guides aggregated within donor/condition. Both true-target and mismatched-target readouts excluded from every arm for fair comparison; no fitted model or independent cross-study validation. Two directions reuse same donors. Condition mean excludes direct perturbation per output; cyclic target mismatch fixed lexicographic derangement. Descriptive equal-weight target-condition means, no statistical independence claim.
